metadata.title: DoluMu — Istanbul transit crowding forecast
metadata.description: Hourly crowding forecasts for Istanbul metro, Metrobüs, bus, Marmaray and ferry lines. See how busy it will be before you ride and pick a quieter time.

common.notLive: Forecasts are built from historical ridership, the calendar and the weather forecast; they are not live counts.

levelHints.quiet: One of the calmer hours of the day
levelHints.peak: The busiest hours of the day

schedule.title: Departures
schedule.unavailable: Timetable isn’t available for this line.
schedule.railFrequency: Trains usually run every 3–10 min. Minute-level metro timetables are temporarily off due to an issue with the Metro İstanbul data source.
schedule.marmarayNote: For Marmaray departures, check TCDD Taşımacılık.
schedule.ferryNote: Ferry times can change with the weather; check the pier or operator for the current timetable.
schedule.planned: Planned timetable; real-time delays are not included.

route.title: Route
route.unavailable: No route data for this line.

details.title: How is this forecast made?
details.body: A machine-learning model predicts riders per hour from 2022–2024 hourly İstanbulkart taps, the calendar (holidays, school terms) and the weather forecast.
details.relative: Colours follow this line’s own daily pattern: “Very busy” means close to that day’s most crowded hours.
details.confidenceLow: The capacity estimate has low confidence, so the occupancy figure is approximate.
details.confidenceStatic: Rail capacity comes from a fixed per-train capacity table.

line.noCalm: No clearly calm period during the day

settings.title: Settings
settings.installDesc: Open DoluMu with one tap, like an app.
settings.iosTitle: Add to your iPhone home screen
settings.iosStep1: Tap the Share button in Safari’s toolbar.
settings.otherBrowserBody: Use “Add to home screen” or “Install app” from your browser menu.
settings.reportDesc: Bug, wrong data or a feature idea
settings.aboutBody: DoluMu is an independent project that forecasts hourly crowding on Istanbul public transport. It is not affiliated with İBB or the operators.
settings.sourcesBody: İBB Open Data Portal (hourly ridership; İBB Open Data License), Metro İstanbul (lines, stations, service status, lift/escalator outages, fares; live), İETT (current lines, stops, live vehicle positions, planned timetables, notices), Open-Meteo (weather), İBB UYM (traffic index), OpenStreetMap / OpenFreeMap (map, Marmaray stations).
settings.dataDesc: Favourites and recent searches are stored only on this device.
